Ngoc Hien Pearl Farm on Đường Trần Hưng Đạo is where you see exactly how South Sea pearls go from oyster to jewelry. Live farm tour, pearl grading demo, and a showroom where you can actually buy direct.

Phu Quoc pearls are genuinely world-class. This is the right place to learn why before you spend a cent.
